The main finding is that station names are not unique. Several recur with different founders and years: Slatemoor (f003 and f005, both 1945 with different founders), Valemoor, Heathgate (three files), Moormere (four files) and Quillmoor (three files).

The table rows were extracted by a regex over the sentences and I did not hand-check each row. Elevation, population, occupation and wind-interval fields are not tabulated, because the brief did not ask for them.

I ran past the USD 0.30 budget by a small amount while writing the report.
